latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker AI Best — fast, easy cloud video creation.

- Upload video clips or images (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 500MB).
- Describe your desired video; AI combines, edits, and exports a polished MP4 in 1-2 minutes (1080p by default).
- Handles music, transitions, text overlays, aspect ratio, and audio tracks.
- No editing skills or software needed; ideal for creators and marketers.
- Automatic session and token management; free 7-day trial with 100 credits.
- Supports instant export, timeline previews, and clear error handling.
